description: Add a company the rep sells, optionally narrowed to some of its brands (e.g. company "Stryker", brands ["Triathlon", "Mako"]); saving a company again replaces its brands, and none means the whole company. With remove true, drop that company. Use only when the user says what they sell.

brands.description: Brand names the rep carries; omit for the whole company.

company.description: The company as it reports to Open Payments, e.g. Stryker, Zimmer Biomet, Johnson & Johnson MedTech.

remove.description: true to remove this company from the rep's lines.

name: set_my_lines
title: Set a line I carry
